title: Awesome for first time visit
text: Tour guide was fantastic! Right about amount of information was given, not too much, not too little. Flamenco show and tapas after was excellent. They served a lot of food.
author: Mike_P

title: This was such a fun thing...
text: This was such a fun thing to do.  Show was only 40 minutes long so it was just the right amount of time for a late evening event.  Dinner was so much food!  Much more than I expected.  Tour was 2 hours long before the show.  Again, much more than I expected.  Only issue we had was finding the tour guide in the beginning.  Instructions said she would be wearing a blue hat.  That is what we were looking for and she told us they don't really wear them.  There were only the 2 of us in the tour so there wasn't a group to be looking for.  Guide was very knowledgeable though once we found her!
author: Betsy_J
